kurz: A tiny pinch of baking soda makes onions turn soft and brown much faster.
bild_im_kopf: Like an accelerator pedal for browning and softening at the same time.
was_passiert: Baking soda makes the surroundings alkaline. That speeds up the [[maillard-reaktion|Maillard reaction]] and dissolves the cell glue faster. The onions turn soft, almost creamy, and deep brown in a fraction of the time.
typische_fehler: Too much baking soda: the onions turn mushy and taste soapy.
schritte: Sweat the onions in oil or butter over medium heat.
Sprinkle over a tiny pinch of baking soda and stir.
Keep frying until golden brown and soft.
If needed, loosen the bottom of the pan with a splash of water.
